step_matches.reason: Both have the requestor log in and open the Request a New Account page.
Both have the requestor download the DAR template.
Both have the requestor complete the DAR; the AI splits the signing out to a different actor, but the completion action matches.
Both have the requestor upload the signed DAR.
Both have the requestor fill in the required account request fields.
Both have the requestor select the account privileges.
Both have the requestor submit the account request.
Both have Operations staff review the DAR for accuracy and completeness.
Both have Operations staff contact the applicant for more information.
Both have Operations staff provide the DAR to the DAC.
Both have the DAC review the information and authorize data access.
Both have the Admin establish the account with privileges matching the authorized access.
Both have the Admin send the automated activation email.
Both have the requestor check the inbox for the approval message.
The AI places checking spam or contacting the team only in a decision branch label, not as a step.
Both have the requestor return to the website and log in.
Both have the requestor access NTRR data.

decision_matches.reason: Both ask whether the DAR has errors, with Yes leading to contacting the applicant and No leading to providing the DAR to the DAC.
The condition matches and Yes correctly leads to logging in, but the No branch is UNDEFINED rather than leading to a check-spam/contact step.
